🧪  `frames-devnet@v0.1.0`: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-frames-devnet@v0.1.0

We are using this EELS branch for reference: [`devnets/frames/0`](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/tree/devnets/frames/0)

PTAL at the release notes & the test [release tracker](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/issues/3415) for the full scope.
Spec updates only, re-frozen at [`EIPs@3ceef8d`](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/blob/3ceef8d37092c5b13a614746dbce5b1fc3c2dfab/EIPS/eip-8141.md).

**New in v0.1.0:**
- EIP-8141: two-dimensional frame gas, `SIGDATACOPY`, and a relaxed banned-opcode list [EIPs#12062](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12062) & [EIPs#12187](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12187).
- EIP-8141: frame target access charged at frame entry [EIPs#12211](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12211).
- EIP-8141: precompiles dispatch in `VERIFY` frames [EIPs#12157](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12157).
- EIP-8141: approval scope statically banned on atomic batches [EIPs#12109](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/12109).
